sections.shortTitle: Chief Executive Order 27 Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the National Assembly Amendment Order 2002
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 27 OF 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S ORDER 27 OF 2002
RULES OF PROCEDURE
AND CONDUCT OF BUSINESS IN THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2002
An Order further
to amend the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the National
Assembly, 1992
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part. I, 20th September, 2002]
F.No.2(4)/2002-Pub. dated
20-9-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement. ---(1) This Order may be called the Rules of Procedure and
Conduct of Business in the National Assembly (Amendment) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
